Knowledge Artifact Metadata
Name (machine-readable) TrustDemoIND03
Title (human-readable) TD.IND.03 CHW referrals for verification completed at the clinic
Status Draft
Experimental true
Description

Of the referrals community health workers make for a child's foreign cards to be verified, the proportion completed at the clinic.
Measure Steward litlfred
Steward Contact Details litlfred: https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo
Measure Metadata
Version Number 0.1.0
Measure Scoring Proportion
Measure Population Criteria
Denominator Description:

Referrals for verification made by community health workers in the reporting period. Computation: COUNT of referrals (TD.J2B) WHERE "Referred at" is in the reporting period
Numerator Description:

Referrals made in the reporting period for which the clinic has recorded an outcome for every dose the referral lists. Computation: COUNT of referrals (TD.J2B) WHERE "Referred at" is in the reporting period AND "Referral status" = completed
Stratifier Code: Referred to
Description:

the clinic referred to
Stratifier Code: Referred by
Description:

the community health worker
